title: GI bleed, home; condition, pending results and goals of care sections hold only cross-references ('See progress note', 'See above', 'Per CM')

rationale.discharge_condition: 'Discharge Condition: See progress note' points to a document that was not provided and the summary itself never states the condition at discharge.
rationale.pending_results: 'See above' refers back to the hospital course, which mentions gastric biopsies for H. pylori but never says whether they are pending or who will follow them up.
rationale.goals_of_care: 'Goals of Care: Per CM' defers to the case management note, which contains no code status, advance directive or stated goals.
rationale.followup: The summary defers follow-up to the nursing instructions, which do list Dr. Ellison on 2026-11-25 and GI in 8 weeks; nursing instructions are an accepted document for this rule.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
